Forms are removed when remove_forms is true

```python title="Python"
from html_to_markdown import convert, ConversionOptions, PreprocessingOptions

def main() -> None:
    html = "<p>Before</p><form><input type='text'/><button>Submit</button></form><p>After</p>"
    options = ConversionOptions(preprocessing=PreprocessingOptions(remove_forms=True))
    result = convert(html, options)
    print(result.content)

main()
```
